title: Length of a read block
statement: Let $\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a bit sequence, and let $i,w\in\mathbb{N}$. The block consisting of the $w$ bits $\tau(i),\tau(i+1),\ldots,\tau(i+w-1)$ has length $w$.
